description: A query that matches nothing anywhere. Every chip renders at 0 - dimmed but present and still clickable - because a visible zero is an answer and a missing chip is not, and the empty line names the query back so the user can see what was actually searched. This is the state that proves the page degrades to an honest 'nothing here' rather than to a blank screen, and the Page contents panel still offers its button, since the most likely reason a remembered phrase finds nothing in the index is that the phrase was in the page's text rather than its title — which is exactly the scan this panel runs.
